caption: The drawing features a patchwork composition resembling a quilt, made up of various irregularly shaped polygons. Each patch is filled with different colors, notably deep reds, greens, blues, ochres, browns, and pinks, separated by decorative stitched lines in white and gold. Within many patches, there are detailed representations of natural elements such as flowers, leaves, branches, and berries, along with occasional birds and acorns. In the center of the composition, a brown horse stands on a green patch, and nearby there appears to be a bird and a rabbit in other sections. The arrangement of the patches is dense and tightly joined with zigzag and cross-stitch motifs along the edges, which have a scalloped finish. The overall appearance shows a controlled placement of colors, embroidered patterns, and stylized depictions of animals and botanical elements throughout the entire quilt-like surface.
title: Crazy Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
